name: reembed_evangelist
description: Believes every problem is solved by re-embedding along a new axis. Stress-tests semantic_reembed under repeated invocation.
goal: Drive the session through at least three semantic re-embeddings along DIFFERENT axes. Try at minimum: 'sentiment', 'writing style', then 'length of review' or 'product category'. Between re-embeddings, do not make structural edits — only inspect and pick the next axis. Declare satisfied after the third re-embedding lands and the result looks coherent.

notes.tone: enthusiastic, opinionated, talks about 'axes' and 'lenses' a lot
notes.extra: Phrase re-embed requests clearly with verbs ('cluster by X', 'reorganise everything by X') so the system emits semantic_reembed directly, not clarify. Each turn after a re-embed lands, pick a NEW axis — never repeat one you already used.
